en: The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a parade or public demonstration. The foreground features a group of young women dressed in traditional folk costumes, including embroidered vests, aprons, and headscarves, holding distaffs with wool. Behind them, a crowd carries signs and banners with Cyrillic text, suggesting a political or celebratory event. The background includes shop signs also in Cyrillic script and a densely packed crowd, indicating an urban setting.
